SOURCE_IMPORT.check: exact source/resources, importer/rest transform and active scene

CAMERA_OBSERVATION.check: exact source, rest state, normalization, camera and render policy

SURFACE_GEOMETRY.check: surface/query/frame and distance semantics independent of global sign

SURFACE_TOPOLOGY.check: mechanical equivalence, connectivity and measured candidate courts; source fallback receives identical checks

SIGNED_DISTANCE_OCCUPANCY.check: source inspection, explicit assembly, independently qualified boundary, sign and distance to the same boundary

ORIENTED_NORMALS.check: same source triangles, winding, normal transform and coordinate frame

APPEARANCE_CAA.check: same source/resources, observation addressing and renderer; downstream rebind if carrier changes

VISIBILITY_OCCLUSION.check: same source surfaces, pose, cameras, ray addressing and student observability; no modularity assumption

RAY_COMPOSITING.check: same measured pose/camera/material/ray domain and observability admission

CAUSAL_RESPONSE.check: preserve source intervention tensors; regenerate adjacency/rebound descendants only if their surface changes

RIG_HIERARCHY.check: authored joint identity, hierarchy/rest transforms and importer equivalence

SKIN_WEIGHTS.check: source vertex/joint addresses, weights and bind matrices; changed carrier requires a separately qualified mapping

ANIMATION_KINEMATICS.check: authored channels, time domain, bind state and independent canonical replay
